sloka: पुत्रो दशरथस्येष सिम्हसम्हननो युवा ।दूषणो निहतो येन खरश्च त्रिशिरास्तथा ॥६-३०-२८॥।।
transliteration: putro daśarathasyeṣa simhasamhanano yuvā ।dūṣaṇo nihato yena kharaśca triśirāstathā ॥6-30-28॥।।

translations.english: "That young one whose build is like a lion is Dasaratha's son who slayed Dushana, even Khara, like wise Trisira."
